| # bds_out_aov_getStatus {#bds_out_aov_getstatus-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Provides status of an analog voltage output.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- The status data holds all relevant information of the analog voltage output, see example below.

oPart of the status data is also the fault status of every DFC (e.g. stDFC_SCB_u16), see topic [Proportional outputs](proportional-outputs.html){.topiclink} and [Diagnostic Fault Check](diagnostic-fault-check.html){.topiclink}.

oWith the macros (e.g. bds_dsm_DFC_ldf) defined in bds_dsm_api.h , respective bit fields of the fault status can be read.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  This API can be used in trusted partitions. For untrusted partitions use bds_out_aov_getStatus_ffi. See [Freedom from Interference (FFI) concept](freedom-from-interference.html){.topiclink} for more details.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
